# App Store Screenshots

Auto-generated screenshots for App Store Connect submission.

**Generated by `MockDataSeeder.swift` + iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator (iOS 26.4, en-AU locale).**

## Files

### iPhone 6.9" (1320 × 2868)
Required for iPhone class. Apple accepts these for ALL iPhone screenshot slots (6.9" / 6.7" / 6.5" / 5.5").

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `iPhone_6.9/01_log.png` | Log tab — 5 TODO notes incl. one red hazard, Sydney CBD Tower site |
| `iPhone_6.9/02_calendar.png` | Calendar tab — May 2026, today selected, 2 TODOs below |
| `iPhone_6.9/03_reports.png` | Reports tab — 4 recent PDF site diaries listed |

## How they're produced

```bash
# Pre-set defaults so app skips perm dialogs + has cached location
xcrun simctl spawn <DEVICE> defaults write com.banruoyang.sitenote ScreenshotMode -string YES

# Launch with screenshot mode + target tab
xcrun simctl launch <DEVICE> com.banruoyang.sitenote -ScreenshotMode YES -StartTab record
```

`MockDataSeeder.swift` activates when `ScreenshotMode == "YES"` and:
- Inserts 6 realistic Sydney-themed notes (Acme Construction client)
- Inserts 2 SitePresets (Sydney CBD Tower, Bondi Mixed-Use)
- Creates 4 mock PDF archives for the Reports tab
- Bypasses onboarding + location / notification dialogs

## What's mocked vs real

| Field | Source |
|---|---|
| Note text | Mock — realistic Sydney site issues (rebar, formwork, handrails, etc.) |
| Site name | Mock — "Sydney CBD Tower" + "Bondi Mixed-Use" |
| Client | Mock — "Acme Construction" |
| User name | Mock — "Sam Chen" |
| Photo thumbs | Mock — Core Graphics gradients with SF Symbol overlay |
| PDFs | Mock — minimal 1-page PDFs with "Daily Site Diary" title |

All content is **clearly fictional** — no real customer data, no real company info.

## iPad

iPad is **not yet ready** (`IPadRootView` is a placeholder per `IPAD_PLAN.md`). To unblock App Store, set `TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY = "1"` in pbxproj (iPhone only). v1.0 launch will be iPhone-only; iPad layout in v1.1.

This has been done in commit `release: limit to iPhone-only + bump CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION 10 → 11`. New build required.

## Upload steps (App Store Connect)

1. Go to App Store Connect → SiteNotes → App Store tab → 1.0 version
2. Scroll to **"App Previews and Screenshots"**
3. Pick **"iPhone 6.9"** (or 6.7" — Apple accepts the same shot for both)
4. Drag in the 3 PNGs from `iPhone_6.9/`
5. Order: 01 → 02 → 03

## To re-shoot

If you change app UI and want fresh screenshots:

```bash
cd /Users/banruo/Developer/SiteNote
# Pick a fresh sim or erase the existing one
xcrun simctl erase <DEVICE>
xcrun simctl boot <DEVICE>
xcodebuild -project SiteNote.xcodeproj -scheme SiteNote \
  -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=<DEVICE>" build
# Then use the capture() helper from this script's history
```
